step_1_lessons_lifecycle.description: Initialize and verify the lessons folder structure and helper functions.
actions: Inspect `tools/lesson_manager.py` to see existing helper functions.
Ensure the directories `lessons/observations/`, `lessons/candidates/`, `lessons/promoted/`, and `lessons/deprecated/` are automatically created on startup.
Implement or verify helper functions to create observation JSONs, promote lessons, and load promoted lessons.

step_2_hitl_config_and_logic.description: Implement the HITL pause and resume logic with console and file-based interaction.
actions: Add `HITL_EVERY_N_CYCLES = 3` to `config.py` if not already present.
In `main.py`, track the completed iteration count.
After every `HITL_EVERY_N_CYCLES` iterations, trigger a pause.
Write a summary of the completed cycles to `status/last_summary.md` and print it to the console.
Wait for operator input via console (`input()`) or via command files in `commands/`.

step_3_phone_git_control.description: Implement file-based remote control via the `commands/` directory and status updates.
actions: Create the `commands/` and `commands/done/` directories if they do not exist.
Implement a periodic check in the main loop of `main.py` to scan `commands/` for files named `pause`, `continue`, `stop`, or `note` (or files containing those commands).
When a command file is detected, process it, log the action, and move the file to `commands/done/` (with a timestamp or unique name to avoid collisions).
Update `status/current.md` at the start of each iteration with the current step, iteration count, and status.

step_4_reviewer_and_researcher_integrati.description: Integrate lessons into the Reviewer and Researcher components.
actions: Modify the Reviewer component (or the review step in `main.py`) so that if a build/test fails with a clear root cause, an observation JSON is written to `lessons/observations/`.
Modify the Researcher component (or the prompt generation in `main.py`) to load all JSON files from `lessons/promoted/` and inject their contents into the system prompt or context.
Create a smoke test script or run a short verification loop to confirm that status files are updated, command files are processed, HITL pauses trigger correctly, and lessons are loaded/saved.
